title: AI delivers ‘zero financial payoff’ to most companies, Apollo economist says
script:
Zero financial payoff. Apollo Global Management chief economist Torsten Sløk revealed this for corporate America.
Only the technology sector sees any real gains from the massive spending.
Corporate America poured billions into AI systems over recent years.
The New York asset manager analyzed economic data to track the actual returns.
Will your company ever see a return on its AI budget?

editor.one_line: Strong script and hook ruined by generic stock code and text-only visuals.
visual_notes: line 1: Text-only screens hold too long without dynamic B-roll or dynamic graphic elements.
line 2: Unrelated generic code and terminal screen stock images used for the tech sector mention.
line 3: Uses a generic text card instead of showing financial charts or corporate logos.
line 4: Repeats text-only cards ('New York asset manager') instead of showing Apollo Global Manage
line 5: Generic closing text card instead of a dynamic summary graphic.
